seo.title: Triathlon coaching – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Personal 1:1 triathlon coaching: close support, replies in under 3 hours (daily 6am–10pm), day-to-day planning in TrainingPeaks.

title: Triathlon coaching
lead: To me, coaching is a relationship, not a service. I support you personally and hands-on – with genuine interest in you as a person, fast replies and planning that adapts to your life day by day.

offer.title: Premium Coaching
offer.text: I know my athletes – their goals, their everyday life, their strengths and the days when things don't go to plan. That's what good coaching is about. We stay in ongoing contact: heavy legs, a business trip, a sick child or a great day – I adjust your training right away. When needed, we plan day by day.
features: A personal relationship on equal terms – I know you, not just your data
Day-to-day planning in TrainingPeaks when needed
Immediate adjustments to life, form and health
Analysis of your training and performance data
offer.note: Limited spots – because a personal relationship takes time.

process.title: Getting to know each other
process.text: In a free intro call we get to know each other: your goals, your story, your everyday life.

process.title: Analysis
process.text: I review your training data and define the starting point.

process.title: Start in TrainingPeaks
process.text: Your training is planned in TrainingPeaks – clear on your phone, watch and bike computer.

process.title: Ongoing conversation
process.text: We stay in close contact and adjust training whenever needed – day by day if required.

faq.question: How fast do you reply?
faq.answer: I'm available every day from 6am to 10pm and reply within 3 hours during that time.

faq.question: Which platform do you use for planning?
faq.answer: TrainingPeaks. You see your sessions there, can sync them to your watch and bike computer, and your data uploads automatically – so I always have your training in view.

faq.question: What does day-to-day planning mean?
faq.answer: Instead of a rigid weekly plan, we can set your training fresh each day when needed – matched to your form, your sleep and your schedule.

faq.question: Why is the personal relationship so important to you?
faq.answer: Because training only works when it fits the person. The better I know you, the better I can judge what you need right now – a push, a brake or simply someone who listens.

faq.question: Who is the coaching for?
faq.answer: Ambitious athletes who want close, personal support – from a first triathlon to the full distance.
